say:1:1623477001:1.text: Don't worry, everything we've promised will be delivered. You'll get what's coming to you.
say:1:1623477001:1.source_cn: 不必有任何顾虑，我们做出的所有承诺都会一一兑现的。

say:2:1623477002:1.text: As long as you steer the Lyceum's public opinion in the way we want, we'll bump your pay up to the top tier, just like Bel's.
say:2:1623477002:1.source_cn: 只要按照我们要求的方向去引导莱希拉姆的舆论，你未来的酬...

say:3:1623477003:1.text: But... a lot of students have started questioning the value of magic because of the reports. I'm starting to feel... guilty about it.
say:3:1623477003:1.source_cn: 可是……最近确实有很多学生因为报道而质疑魔法的用处，我...

say:5:1623477004:1.text: Guilty? Those weaklings who can't handle their magic or the pressure—they don't belong in the Lyceum anyway!
say:5:1623477004:1.source_cn: 内疚？那些魔力受损、心理承受能力又差劲的废物，本来就不...

say:6:1623477005:1.text: They're just opportunistic losers looking for an easy way out. They should leave on their own and stay away from magic. It'll clean up our community!
say:6:1623477005:1.source_cn: 他们不过是一群渴望不劳而获的功利小人。他们就该主动选择...

say:7:1623477006:1.text: But Bel... didn't your articles always show sympathy for the mana-damaged students?
say:7:1623477006:1.source_cn: 可巴布你……你之前的文章不是一直站在同情那些魔力受损学...

say:8:1623477007:1.text: That's just the role I was hired to play. Money decides what I write—simple as that.
say:8:1623477007:1.source_cn: 那不过是这份工作的要求罢了。报酬的多少，直接决定了我的...

say:9:1623477008:1.text: And since we're being honest, those nasty hit pieces that dragged them through the mud? Yeah. I wrote those too.
say:9:1623477008:1.source_cn: 不怕告诉你们，之前那些丑化他们的爆款文章，也全都出自我手。

say:10:1623477009:1.text: Only rookies get all precious about "the truth". The smart ones just do whatever gets them paid.
say:10:1623477009:1.source_cn: 只有刚入行的新手，才会天真地死抱着所谓的“真相”不放。...

say:11:1623477010:1.text: That's how this business actually works.
say:11:1623477010:1.source_cn: 这，才是新闻行业的真正规则。

say:13:1623477011:1.text: Hah. I like you, Bel. You get it. We'll keep you on long-term.
say:13:1623477011:1.source_cn: 哈哈……巴布，我很欣赏你的想法，我们会长期找你合作的。
